prompt: Match each platform to the tool that rewrites its release build.

pairs.right: the compiler and linker, stripping symbols

prompt: Why can a release build's trace be shorter than the same crash in a debug build?

choices.text: Release builds catch some exceptions
choices.why: The crash is the same crash.

choices.text: Crash reporters cut traces to save space
choices.why: The shortness came from the build, not the reporter.

choices.text: Inlining removed a method's own frame
choices.why: Right. Its code now lives inside its caller.

choices.text: Renaming merges frames with the same short name
choices.why: Renaming changes names, not the number of frames.

prompt: Why must the mapping come from the build that shipped, and not from a rebuild of the same commit?

choices.text: Each build picks its own names
choices.why: Right. Two builds of one commit choose different names and inlining; only that build's file undoes that build.

choices.text: The mapping holds the signing key
choices.why: It holds names, never keys.

choices.text: A rebuild has no mapping at all
choices.why: It has one, of its own.

choices.text: Rebuilds are refused by the stores
choices.why: The question is about reading traces, not uploading.

prompt: In the minified bundle, every frame says line 1. What tells the frames apart?

choices.text: Nothing; a source map is needed even to tell them apart
choices.why: The column already differs; the map says what it means.

choices.text: The minified function name
choices.why: The second frame had none.

choices.text: The order of the lines in the trace
choices.why: Order says who called whom, not where.

choices.text: The column
choices.why: Right. 75 and 161 in the lesson's trace.

prompt: `symbolicate.ts` subtracts 1 from the column before asking the source map. Why?

choices.text: To skip the opening bracket of the frame
choices.why: The regex already removed the brackets.

choices.text: Traces count columns from 1, the map from 0
choices.why: Right. And 1 is added back when printing.

choices.text: The bundle starts with an invisible character
choices.why: It does not; the counting differs.

choices.text: Node reports the column after the error
choices.why: It reports the column of the error.

prompt: On your own computer, Node rewrites a minified trace through its source map at run time when started with `node --enable-___`.
On a phone, why does Hermes not use the source map itself?

choices.text: Hermes cannot read JSON
choices.why: It can; the map is simply not shipped.

choices.text: The map stays on the build machine
choices.why: Right. The server is where the two meet.

choices.text: Source maps are forbidden by the stores
choices.why: No such rule; shipping one would only add size.

choices.text: Hermes symbolicates with a dSYM instead
choices.why: A dSYM is for native iOS code.

prompt: What does `-keepattributes SourceFile,LineNumberTable` give the team?

choices.text: Unshrunk class names
choices.why: Classes are still renamed.

choices.text: A smaller jar
choices.why: Keeping attributes makes it slightly larger.

choices.text: Protection from reverse engineering of the app
choices.why: It does the opposite of hiding.

choices.text: Line numbers retrace maps back
choices.why: Right. Without them no trace can say which line.

prompt: The shrunk trace had one frame, `main` at line 7. Retrace printed two. Where did the second come from?

choices.text: From the mapping
choices.why: Right. It records that totalFor was inlined, and keeps what the trace lost.

choices.text: Retrace ran the unshrunk jar
choices.why: It read two text files; it ran nothing.

choices.text: Retrace guesses missing frames
choices.why: It reads them from the mapping.

choices.text: From Java's own debug information
choices.why: The shrunk jar had lost that frame.

prompt: After retrace, at which line of `Week.java` is the bug?
Why does the lesson's R8 demonstration use Java rather than Kotlin?

choices.text: R8 refuses Kotlin
choices.why: R8 reads bytecode, whatever compiled it.

choices.text: Java crashes are easier to read
choices.why: The trace looks the same.

choices.text: The JDK compiles it with nothing else installed
choices.why: Right. Kotlin compiles to the same bytecode.

choices.text: Android apps are written in Java
choices.why: Most new ones are Kotlin; R8 does not care.

prompt: How does a dSYM prove it belongs to a given iOS binary?

choices.text: Both share a UUID from the linker
choices.why: Right. Any other dSYM is refused.

choices.text: By the version name inside it
choices.why: Two builds of one version differ.

choices.text: By the date it was made
choices.why: Dates do not match builds.

choices.text: By its file name, which Xcode sets to match
choices.why: Names can be copied; the UUID cannot.

prompt: A frame reads `0x0000000102f4a8c4 0x102f30000 + 108740`. If the same build loaded at `0x104a00000` on another phone, at which address would the same instruction be? Answer the offset added, in decimal.
An old guide says to download dSYMs from App Store Connect because Apple recompiles the app. What does the lesson say about that?

choices.text: It is still the only way to get them
choices.why: Your own archive has them.

choices.text: It applies only to React Native apps
choices.why: It was about native iOS builds.

choices.text: It was about bitcode, gone since Xcode 14
choices.why: Right. Your build's dSYM now matches what Apple ships.

choices.text: Apple deletes dSYMs after review
choices.why: Nothing says so.

items: keep mapping.txt from the build that shipped

prompt: Which of these files must be kept from each release build? Choose every one.

choices.text: mapping.txt
choices.why: Right, for Android.

choices.text: the .dSYM
choices.why: Right, for iOS.

choices.text: the source map
choices.why: Right, for the JavaScript bundle.

choices.text: the debug keystore
choices.why: It signs nothing that ships.

prompt: A retraced trace names methods that make no sense for the crash. What is the likeliest cause?

choices.text: Line numbers were kept in the release build
choices.why: Keeping them is what makes retrace work.

choices.text: The mapping came from another build
choices.why: Right. Confident nonsense.

choices.text: Retrace needs the internet
choices.why: It reads two local files.

choices.text: The app was not minified
choices.why: Then there would be nothing to retrace.
